<!-- pr-reviewer: 962653fd84bebeb6d62bf496dd852d435cbcc6e2 -->
**Needs changes before merge**

Reviewed head 962653fd (`fix(cli): every subcommand answers --help`, Fixes #1296). Trial merge with current `origin/main` (53a52f88) was clean.

### What looks good
- The help check runs before each lane parses its arguments, so `mcp --help` never reaches the JSON-RPC loop. The control case in `mcp_help_does_not_start_the_server` makes that test meaningful.
- The usage texts match the parsers: `process` `-o/--out` and `--cps`, `mcp --connect <host:port>`, `script <job.js>` (checked against `lane_process`, `lane_mcp`, `lane_script`).
- No dependency change (no Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs, .github or scripts in the diff). No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the non-test code added to `cli.rs`.
- Unknown flags and unknown commands still exit 2 with the message on stderr.
- `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #1296`, conventional subject, decision file present.

### Local results (trial merge with origin/main)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test cli` | 11 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean (exit 0) |

Subcommands run from the built `camcraft-cli` (stdin from /dev/null):

| Invocation | Exit | Stdout | Stderr |
|---|---|---|---|
| `help` | 0 | usage (22 lines) | empty |
| `version` | 0 | version line | empty |
| `script --help` / `-h` | 0 | usage | empty |
| `process --help` / `-h` | 0 | usage | empty |
| `mcp --help` / `-h` | 0 | usage, no protocol output | empty |
| `script x.js --help` | 0 | usage | empty |
| `process --help x` | 0 | usage | empty |
| `mcp --connect 127.0.0.1:1 --help` | 0 | usage | empty |
| `help --help`, `version --help` | 0 | help / version | empty |
| `mcp --bogus` | 2 | empty | refusal line |
| `script --bogus` | 2 | empty | refusal line |
| `process --bogus` | 2 | empty | refusal line |
| `bogus --help`, `frobnicate` | 2 | empty | unknown command |

### Requested before merge
1. `crates/app/tests/cli.rs`, `every_subcommand_answers_help_and_names_its_flags`: the cases are a hand-written array of three lanes (`script`, `process`, `mcp`). The requirement is that the test is driven from the subcommand list, so a lane added to `command_usage` in `crates/app/src/cli.rs` without a case would pass silently. Fix: expose one list of help-bearing lanes from `cli.rs` (for example a `pub const` pairing each name with its usage text, which `command_usage` also reads), and have the test iterate that list, asserting the flags per lane from the usage text.

### Non-blocking notes
- `help` and `version` ignore extra arguments and exit 0, which is fine. The test does not pin them; it would be cleaner if the list-driven test covered them too.
- The CLI docs page (#1294) still says subcommands do not take `--help`, as the PR body already notes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 49e33c12c595d2a695c1c94aa2c9ec59b6d2dfd2 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Re-review of head 49e33c12 against my earlier review of 962653fd. Trial merge with current `origin/main` was clean.

### Earlier request, now addressed
1. Help test driven from the subcommand list: `pub const HELP_LANES` in `crates/app/src/cli.rs` pairs each lane with its usage text. `command_usage` reads it, and `every_subcommand_answers_help_and_names_its_flags` iterates it. The test derives the flags per lane from the usage text and asserts the output equals the lane's usage. The new `every_listed_command_is_a_help_lane` parses the top-level COMMANDS block and fails if a listed command has no lane entry. This is the fix I asked for. The only remaining gap is a lane that is in neither the list nor COMMANDS, which is acceptable.

### What looks good
- The help check still runs before any lane parses, so `mcp --help` never starts the server. The control case in `mcp_help_does_not_start_the_server` keeps that test meaningful.
- No dependency, build.rs, .github or scripts change. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in the added non-test code. Unknown flags still exit 2.
- Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1296`, and the decision file is present.

### Local results (merged with main)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test cli` | 12 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

### Notes (not blocking)
- A lane added to `HELP_LANES` but not to the dispatch `match` in `run` would report "unknown command". That is a visible refusal, not a silent one.
- The CLI docs page (#1294) still needs its one-line update after this merges, as the PR body says.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
